canon_ref.note: How long they were mad is unknown. Under the spell Pisces plays his father, a fencing master; Yvlon plays Byres forebears, one of them calling himself Ylawes Byres (a persona, not linked to any NPC).

b3.ksmvr_and_ceria_smother_the_insanity_.summary: Ceria's half-Elf blood keeps waking her, but each time the glowing rune drags her back. Ksmvr, fighting the spell through his Antinium conditioning, cuts her trousers into a blindfold. Guided by his calls, she smears conjured mud over the rune as Pisces and Yvlon duel.

canon_ref.note: Ksmvr reasons the pit must have an air hole, and his eyes find it in the ceiling. Yvlon stays mad for hours and is kept tied up.

b3.pisces_builds_a_bone_stair_out_of_the.summary: Pisces, himself again, lifts the bones of countless dead adventurers into a floating stair, and his skeletons dig up to the tunnel. A falling skeleton knocks loose old tar from a wall: the whole pit is lined with the rune. Ceria takes a dead adventurer's pack.

canon_ref.note: Day guess: they may have lost hours or days in the pit. Warmage Thresk is named only by his guardian; no NPC.

b3.horns_break_into_warmage_thresks_vaul.summary: They come out right before the door that trapped them. Skeletons chip at the stone round its hinges until it falls in, revealing a small vault: glowing weapons, shelves of spellbooks, gold and gems, and a staff whose power both mages can see.

canon_ref.note: Ceria's [Ice Spike] and [Frozen Wind] do nothing to it. Pisces gets badly burnt; Ksmvr's sword melts. The last page shows all four passing out in the heat of the pit.

b3.yvlon_shatters_the_flame_guardian.summary: A man of white fire rises to guard the vault. It ashes the skeletons and walls them in. Using the spell-proof door as a shield they stun it, and Yvlon cuts its heart-gem; her silver armour melts onto her arms. Dying, it burns the vault. Pisces' skeletons fetch what they can.

system.name: [Flash Step]
system.note: An old spell of his; Ceria thinks his footwork has slipped since Wistram.

system.name: [Ice Spike]
system.note: Her best spell; at full effort she fires one from each finger.
